Based on the document, here are the answers to the questions:

**Q1. What is the main difference between generative and discriminative classifiers?**

**Answer**: A. Generative models model P(x, y), while discriminative models model P(y | x)

---

**Q2. Which technique is used to mitigate overfitting by penalizing large weights?**

**Answer**: B. Regularization

---

**Q3. What is the limitation of the perceptron algorithm?**

**Answer**: B. It only works for linearly separable data

---

**Q4. Why is Laplace smoothing important?**

**Answer**: C. It avoids zero probabilities for unseen words

---

**Q5. What happens in stochastic gradient descent (SGD) compared to gradient descent (GD)?**

**Answer**: B. SGD updates weights using one or a subset of training examples

---

**Q6. What is the core intuition behind word embeddings?**

**Answer**: B. Words that appear in similar contexts have similar meanings

---

**Q7. What is the primary purpose of the Softmax function?**

**Answer**: D. To convert raw class scores into a valid probability distribution

---

**Q8. In the perceptron algorithm, when are the weights updated?**

**Answer**: C. Only when the prediction is incorrect

---

**Q9. What is the main goal of TF-IDF weighting?**

**Answer**: D. Highlight words that are frequent in a document but rare across documents

---

**Q10. Why is cosine similarity preferred over dot product when comparing word vectors?**

**Answer**: A. It ignores vector length while calculating similarity
